mathematics.assertion_tested: All 1895 parameter records and their 45480 stored integer terms, rational components, source-index maps and displayed coefficient representations agree with independent exact constructions. This includes 112 research-derived secancy/theta records (2688 terms), checked by rising-factorial expansion and an independent formal polynomial recurrence. Full matching reproduces the retained OEIS report.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z and Q, exact Python integers and Fraction arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: 24 terms per record. Original parameter windows n=0..23; secancy columns k=1..8 begin at n=k; theta columns k=1..12 begin at n=ceil(k/2); theta specializations x=1..12 begin at n=0. Source degrees: reciprocal/CE/secancy Nn; tangent N(n+1)-1; Appell n; classical section Nn+j; theta 2n. Polynomial coefficients are ordinary coefficients, without k! scaling. Rational components are reduced with positive denominators. OEIS positions are export positions, not mathematical offsets.
inputs: Official OEIS terms and names snapshot dated 2026-11-15
non_claims: No novelty, distinctness, or general proof is inferred from the finite computation
OEIS matches do not prove infinite sequence identities
